title: Kinsta Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Test Results and Black Friday Offer
excerpt: A Kinsta review from the host's own pages and one named independent test, with plan prices, the Black Friday offer and AI features.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Kinsta Review 2026: Pricing, Speed and Black Friday
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Kinsta review for 2026: plan prices, the Black Friday offer to 1 Dec, a six-week test from EXPERTE, support, AI features, pros and cons, from named sources.
meta.rl_answer: Kinsta is a premium managed WordPress host. EXPERTE measured 99.977% uptime over 6 weeks. The Black Friday offer is for new customers and ends 1 December.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Kinsta worth it? | It can be for a business site that needs speed and support. EXPERTE measured 99.977% uptime over 6 weeks. The cost is the main con.
How much does Kinsta cost? | The Launch plan lists at $35 a month. Larger plans run to $299 a month, agency plans to $675, and enterprise from $500.
Does Kinsta have a Black Friday deal? | Yes: 50% off for 3 months on monthly plans, or 3 months free on annual billing. It is for new customers and ends on 1 December 2026.
Does Kinsta have phone support? | EXPERTE reports AI and live chat support, with no phone line.
Does Kinsta have a money-back guarantee? | Kinsta lists a 30-day money-back guarantee on its pricing page.
Does Kinsta have AI features? | We found no built-in AI assistant on the pricing page. Kinsta has an API and an APM tool, and it publishes tutorials on building an MCP server.

meta.rl_takeaways:
The Launch plan lists at $35 a month, with 75,000 visits and 15 GB.
EXPERTE measured 99.977% uptime and a 0.23 second time to first byte over 6 weeks.
The Black Friday offer ends on 1 December 2026 and is for new customers.
No built-in AI assistant on the pricing page.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
Time to first byte | How long a server takes to start sending a page.
Managed WordPress hosting | Hosting set up and looked after for WordPress only.
APM | Application performance monitoring, a tool that shows what slows a site down.
